name: cass15-safeguarding-audit-pack
title: CASS 15 Safeguarding Audit Pack
description: Three-step safeguarding audit pack for a UK payment or e-money firm under CASS 15. Step 1 classifies each declared funds stream's safeguarding method and records whether the asserted method is coherent on the supplied facts (art-500). Step 2 reconciles the safeguarding requirement against the resource components for the same as-of date, returning a covered, tolerance or shortfall verdict with the gap in minor units (art-499). Step 3 assembles the auditor's evidence pack over the classification and the reconciliation result, itemising each evidence element with its supporting figures (art-501). Each step computes from its own declared inputs; the order is analytical, not a statutory sequence.

steps.handoff: Classifies each declared funds stream's safeguarding method and records whether the asserted method is coherent on the supplied facts, returning a per-stream classification with an overall coherence verdict. Stage 1 of 3. Step 2 then reconciles the safeguarding requirement against the resource components for the same as-of date.

Reconciles the safeguarding requirement against the resource components for the declared as-of date, returning a covered, tolerance or shortfall verdict with the residual gap in minor units. Stage 2 of 3. Step 3 then assembles the auditor's evidence pack over that reconciliation.
Assembles the auditor's evidence pack over the declared classification and reconciliation inputs, itemising each evidence element with its supporting figures and overall pack status. Final stage.
